subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU, TPS, concurrency, token mix
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@orbitai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU, TPS, concurrency, token mix

Hi Samantha — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can size Dedicated correctly: 

- Models discussed: Llama2-70B (primary), occasional RAG over private embeddings
- Peak TPS target: you mentioned high request bursts; can you confirm peak requests/sec vs sustained?
- Concurrency: any hard concurrency limits (simultaneous inferences)? You noted many small callers but also batch inference for nightly jobs
- Token mix: average prompt length, average completion length, and % of long contexts (>=2k tokens)
- Preferred GPU: you called out H100 as ideal; do you have procurement constraints for A100 only?
- Latency SLO: any p95/p99 targets we should design for?
- KV/prefix caching: how many requests would benefit from caching (session chat vs stateless)?

Attached is our sizing template (redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx) — if you can fill or send rough numbers that will let our infra team build an initial capacity plan. Also, if you have any sample payloads (JSON), please send them so we can estimate token cost and payload overhead.

Next steps: once we have the numbers Aditya (cc'd) can set up a sizing call to walk through GPU tradeoffs and a cost estimate. I listed a couple of times below, or book directly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

Times I suggested: Thu 2/26 11:00am ET or Tue 3/2 10:00am ET

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@orbitai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@orbitai.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU, TPS, concurrency, token mix

Hi Marissa — great to talk. See answers below based on our internal numbers; I pulled these from our usage dashboard and chatted with DevOps.

- Model(s): Llama2-70B (main), occasional smaller 13B for quick responses
- Sustained requests/sec: ~60 rps sustained during business hours
- Peak burst: spikes up to ~180 rps for short windows (1-5 mins) during marketing campaigns
- Concurrent inferences: typically 35-45 concurrent requests; we see spikes to ~70 during campaigns
- Average token mix: prompt ~400 tokens, completion ~350 tokens (avg ~750 total)
- Long-context usage: ~25% of calls request extended context (>=2k tokens)
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 400ms, p99 aim for <= 800ms but tolerable for some long-context requests
- Preferred GPU: H100 ideal for latency; procurement team prefers H100 but A100 is acceptable if cost savings are significant
- State / caching: session-based chat (KV cache would help ~40% of requests)
- Data residency: US only, VPC peering expected (we'll need a private VPC option for dedicated)
- Timeline: aiming to go live on Dedicated by end of Q2 (June)

I've attached a small sample payloads file (I'll send via separate email or upload) — for now, I've pasted a couple of representative request sizes inlined below. Budget: we're evaluating a 12-month commitment but need a baseline cost estimate for procurement.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of AI
OrbitAI

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@orbitai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 08:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU, TPS, concurrency, token mix

Thanks Samantha — this is very helpful. A few clarifying items so our sizing is aligned: 

1) Sustained vs burst: is the 60 rps a baseline you expect 24/7 during business hours (i.e., sustained over several hours), or is it concentrated to a 2–4 hour window each day? That affects autoscaling/oversubscription planning.
2) For the 25% long-context calls, are those evenly distributed or concentrated to a small subset of users?
3) Can you share sample payloads (we requested example-payloads.json) and any traffic patterns (time-of-day CSV) — these let us simulate effective throughput and memory needs.
4) Procurement constraint: if H100 is approved, we can target lower GPU counts with better latency. If you end up on A100-only, we'll provide a cost/latency tradeoff.

Aditya — would you and Jonas be available for a 30-minute sizing call this week? Suggested times: Tue 3/3 9:00am ET or Tue 3/3 2:00pm ET.

I'll hold the template open; Samantha, if you can drop the payloads into the reply (or share a Drive link) we'll run an initial estimate and get back with a recommended config (GPU type & count, average tokens/sec, expected p95/p99).

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@orbitai.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU, TPS, concurrency, token mix

Thanks — looping in preliminary sizing notes based on Samantha's numbers. High-level estimate for Llama2-70B (approximation, final will come after running payload sims):

Option A (latency-first, H100):
- GPU: H100 (80GB)
- Count: 4 GPUs baseline for sustained 60 rps with average 750 tokens/request and 25% long-context; autoscale headroom to handle 180 rps spikes (burst pooling + queuing)
- Concurrency per GPU: target ~10-12 concurrent seq-infer sessions (with KV cache enabled)
- Expected p95: ~300–450ms; p99 ~700–900ms for long contexts

Option B (cost-aware, A100):
- GPU: A100 (80GB)
- Count: 8 GPUs baseline (higher count due to lower perf per GPU)
- Concurrency per GPU: ~6–8 concurrent sessions
- Expected p95: ~450–650ms; p99 ~900ms+ for long contexts

Notes / questions:
- These assume efficient KV/prefix caching for the 40% sessioned traffic — if caching is lower, GPU counts increase ~15–25%
- If OrbitAI can tolerate slightly higher p95 (500ms) we can favor A100 for lower cost
- We'll run local tokenized payload sims once Samantha shares example-payloads.json; that will influence exact counts and memory footprint

Next steps: Marissa — once we get the payloads I'll schedule a 45-min sizing session with the infra team (I can do Thu 3/5 11am ET). Samantha — if you have any hard procurement constraints or a preferred cap on GPUs, share that and we'll tailor the config.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
